description: This file contains an API client for fetching suggestions based on a prefix. It dynamically determines the base URL depending on the environment variables and provides functions for retrieving suggestions, with fallback options to a public API (Datamuse).

methods.name: getSuggestionsBase()
methods.description: Determines the base URL for suggestions API, prioritizing environment variables and defaulting to Datamuse

methods.name: fetchSuggestions(prefix, lang = "en")
methods.description: Fetches suggestion list for a given prefix and language, with graceful fallback if backend is unavailable or language is non-English
